1→# Specification: Enhanced TV Navigation System
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This specification details the implementation of a production-grade, remote-first navigation system for Apple TV and Android TV platforms. The system addresses Stremio's #1 user complaint (poor TV navigation) and exploits a major market gap where competitors like Kodi struggle with TV/mobile UX. The implementation will deliver a native-feeling experience matching Apple TV+ quality standards, with complete D-pad coverage, intelligent focus management, long-press interactions, and spatial navigation with memory.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: Feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This is a new capability addition to the existing React Native codebase. While some TV navigation infrastructure already exists (useTVEventHandler, Focusable.tv.tsx, useSpatialNavigation), this task requires building a comprehensive, production-ready system that transforms the entire app's navigation paradigm. This is not a refactor of existing functionality but rather the implementation of new features (long-press menus, focus memory, voice search integration) alongside enhancement of existing TV support to meet Apple TV+ quality benchmarks.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **main** (primary) - React Native TypeScript frontend containing all UI components, navigation logic, and TV-specific interaction layers
    17→
    18→### This Task Will:
    19→- [ ] Implement universal D-pad focusability across all UI components
    20→- [ ] Create consistent, visible focus states with smooth animations
    21→- [ ] Build long-press detection system for context menus and quick actions
    22→- [ ] Develop spatial navigation with focus memory that persists across screen transitions
    23→- [ ] Ensure predictable back button behavior throughout the app
    24→- [ ] Integrate TV remote voice search capabilities
    25→- [ ] Eliminate all focus traps and unreachable UI elements
    26→- [ ] Establish reusable TV navigation primitives for future development
    27→
    28→### Out of Scope:
    29→- Web browser TV navigation (focus is Apple TV and Android TV native apps only)
    30→- Mobile phone/tablet touch-optimized navigation improvements
    31→- Smart TV browser apps (Samsung Tizen, LG webOS)
    32→- Game controller support beyond standard TV remotes
    33→- Accessibility features beyond focus management (screen readers, high contrast modes)
    34→
    35→## Service Context
    36→
    37→### main
    38→
    39→**Tech Stack:**
    40→- Language: TypeScript
    41→- Framework: React Native with react-native-tvos
    42→- Navigation: @react-navigation/native v7.1.6
    43→- Animation: react-native-reanimated v4.2.0
    44→- Gesture handling: react-native-gesture-handler v2.29.1
    45→- Key directories: src/, app/, components/
    46→
    47→**Entry Point:** `index.ts`
    48→
    49→**How to Run:**
    50→```bash
    51→# Standard development mode
    52→npm run start
    53→
    54→# TV-specific development mode (APP_VARIANT=tv)
    55→npm run start:tv
    56→
    57→# Prebuild TV native projects
    58→npm run prebuild:tv
    59→```
    60→
    61→**Port:** 3000
    62→
    63→**Platform Detection:**
    64→- Use `Platform.isTV` to detect Apple TV or Android TV
    65→- Metro automatically loads `.tv.tsx` file variants when `APP_VARIANT=tv` is set
    66→- Configuration in `app.json`: `ios.supportsTV: true`
    67→
    68→## Files to Modify
    69→
    70→| File | Service | What to Change |
    71→|------|---------|---------------|
    72→| `/src/hooks/useTVEventHandler.ts` | main | Enhance TV remote event handling to support long-press detection with timing thresholds (Android native, Apple TV custom implementation) |
    73→| `/src/components/common/Focusable.tv.tsx` | main | Add focus state animations using react-native-reanimated, implement `tvParallaxProperties` for Apple TV, ensure proper `isTVSelectable` and focus prop handling |
    74→| `/src/hooks/useSpatialNavigation.ts` | main | Implement focus memory storage/retrieval system, add `nextFocus[Up/Down/Left/Right]` logic with node handle management |
    75→| `/src/contexts/TVNavigationContext.tsx` | main | Add global state for focus history, last focused items per screen, voice search state, and context menu visibility |
    76→| `/src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx` | main | Integrate `useFocusEffect` with focus restoration logic using `requestAnimationFrame`, store focus state in `navigation.setParams()` |
    77→| **New:** `/src/components/tv/TVContextMenu.tv.tsx` | main | Create context menu component for long-press actions (Add to List, Mark as Watched, etc.) |
    78→| **New:** `/src/components/tv/TVFocusGuard.tv.tsx` | main | Create boundary component to prevent focus escaping containers, handle circular navigation |
    79→| **New:** `/src/hooks/useLongPress.ts` | main | Create platform-aware long-press detection hook (300ms threshold for Apple TV, native event for Android TV) |
    80→| **New:** `/src/components/tv/TVVoiceSearch.tv.tsx` | main | Create voice search modal/overlay triggered by TV remote voice button |
    81→
    82→## Files to Reference
    83→
    84→These files show patterns to follow:
    85→
    86→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    87→|------|----------------|
    88→| `/src/hooks/useTVEventHandler.ts` | TVEventHandler lifecycle management: `TVEventHandler.enable(component, callback)` on mount, `.disable()` on unmount; existence check before instantiation |
    89→| `/src/components/common/Focusable.tv.tsx` | TV-specific file variant pattern (`.tv.tsx` extension), TV prop handling (`hasTVPreferredFocus`, `isTVSelectable`, `onFocus/onBlur`) |
    90→| `/src/hooks/useSpatialNavigation.ts` | Focus state management patterns, using refs and `findNodeHandle()` for native node access |
    91→| `/src/contexts/TVNavigationContext.tsx` | Global TV state management structure using React Context API |
    92→| `babel.config.js` | Reanimated plugin configuration (must be last plugin in array) |
    93→
    94→## Patterns to Follow
    95→
    96→### Pattern 1: TV-Specific File Variants

    98→From Metro bundler configuration:

   102→src/components/common/Button.tsx        // Default (mobile/web)
   103→src/components/common/Button.tv.tsx     // TV variant (auto-loaded when APP_VARIANT=tv)
   104→

   106→import { Platform } from 'react-native';
   107→
   108→if (Platform.isTV) {
   109→  // TV-specific logic
   110→}
   111→```
   112→
   113→**Key Points:**
   114→- Metro automatically resolves `.tv.tsx` when `APP_VARIANT=tv` environment variable is set
   115→- Always provide fallback `.tsx` for non-TV platforms
   116→- Use `Platform.isTV` for runtime conditional logic within shared files
   117→
   118→### Pattern 2: Reanimated Focus Animations
   119→
   120→From react-native-reanimated best practices:
   121→
   122→```typescript
   123→import { useSharedValue, useAnimatedStyle, withSpring } from 'react-native-reanimated';
   124→
   125→const scale = useSharedValue(1);
   126→const opacity = useSharedValue(1);

   140→  opacity.value = withSpring(0.7);
   141→};
   142→```
   143→
   144→**Key Points:**
   145→- Keep TV animations subtle (scale 1.0-1.1 range)
   146→- Use spring animations with damping: 15, stiffness: 150 for native feel
   147→- Avoid complex animations on Android TV (limited GPU on many devices)
   148→
   149→### Pattern 3: Focus Memory with React Navigation
   150→
   151→From @react-navigation/native integration patterns:

1→# Specification: Enhanced TV Navigation System
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This specification details the implementation of a production-grade, remote-first navigation system for Apple TV and Android TV platforms. The system addresses Stremio's #1 user complaint (poor TV navigation) and exploits a major market gap where competitors like Kodi struggle with TV/mobile UX. The implementation will deliver a native-feeling experience matching Apple TV+ quality standards, with complete D-pad coverage, intelligent focus management, long-press interactions, and spatial navigation with memory.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: Feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This is a new capability addition to the existing React Native codebase. While some TV navigation infrastructure already exists (useTVEventHandler, Focusable.tv.tsx, useSpatialNavigation), this task requires building a comprehensive, production-ready system that transforms the entire app's navigation paradigm. This is not a refactor of existing functionality but rather the implementation of new features (long-press menus, focus memory, voice search integration) alongside enhancement of existing TV support to meet Apple TV+ quality benchmarks.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **main** (primary) - React Native TypeScript frontend containing all UI components, navigation logic, and TV-specific interaction layers

    20→- [ ] Create consistent, visible focus states with smooth animations
    21→- [ ] Build long-press detection system for context menus and quick actions
    22→- [ ] Develop spatial navigation with focus memory that persists across screen transitions
    23→- [ ] Ensure predictable back button behavior throughout the app
    24→- [ ] Integrate TV remote voice search capabilities
    25→- [ ] Eliminate all focus traps and unreachable UI elements
    26→- [ ] Establish reusable TV navigation primitives for future development

1→# Specification: Enhanced TV Navigation System

     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This specification details the implementation of a production-grade, remote-first navigation system for Apple TV and Android TV platforms. The system addresses Stremio's #1 user complaint (poor TV navigation) and exploits a major market gap where competitors like Kodi struggle with TV/mobile UX. The implementation will deliver a native-feeling experience matching Apple TV+ quality standards, with complete D-pad coverage, intelligent focus management, long-press interactions, and spatial navigation with memory.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: Feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This is a new capability addition to the existing React Native codebase. While some TV navigation infrastructure already exists (useTVEventHandler, Focusable.tv.tsx, useSpatialNavigation), this task requires building a comprehensive, production-ready system that transforms the entire app's navigation paradigm. This is not a refactor of existing functionality but rather the implementation of new features (long-press menus, focus memory, voice search integration) alongside enhancement of existing TV support to meet Apple TV+ quality benchmarks.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope

    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **main** (primary) - React Native TypeScript frontend containing all UI components, navigation logic, and TV-specific interaction layers
    17→
    18→### This Task Will:
    19→- [ ] Implement universal D-pad focusability across all UI components
    20→- [ ] Create consistent, visible focus states with smooth animations
    21→- [ ] Build long-press detection system for context menus and quick actions
    22→- [ ] Develop spatial navigation with focus memory that persists across screen transitions
    23→- [ ] Ensure predictable back button behavior throughout the app
    24→- [ ] Integrate TV remote voice search capabilities
    25→- [ ] Eliminate all focus traps and unreachable UI elements
    26→- [ ] Establish reusable TV navigation primitives for future development
    27→
    28→### Out of Scope:
    29→- Web browser TV navigation (focus is Apple TV and Android TV native apps only)
    30→- Mobile phone/tablet touch-optimized navigation improvements
    31→- Smart TV browser apps (Samsung Tizen, LG webOS)

   123→import { useSharedValue, useAnimatedStyle, withSpring } from 'react-native-reanimated';
